subject.title: TUI: Add config support for --deliver flag default

question: Should OpenClaw add a persistent config default for TUI delivery, and should it live under a CLI-scoped path or the existing `tui` config section?
rationale: The issue is valid, but solving it adds a persisted config/default surface for delivery behavior, and repository policy requires maintainer intent before adding new config knobs.

options.title: Approve a CLI-scoped default
options.body: Add an opt-in command default such as `cli.tui.deliver` with explicit `--deliver` override precedence, keeping the existing `tui` section display-focused.

options.title: Approve `tui.deliver`
options.body: Add the requested `tui.deliver` field and update the `tui` config contract to include behavior settings, accepting the broader meaning of that section.

options.title: Keep delivery launch-only
options.body: Leave delivery controlled by `openclaw tui --deliver` and update/confirm docs so users understand aliases are the supported persistence mechanism.

recommendation.title: Approve a CLI-scoped default
recommendation.body: Add an opt-in command default such as `cli.tui.deliver` with explicit `--deliver` override precedence, keeping the existing `tui` section display-focused.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about OpenClaw config/product surface, and the strongest current history signal for the config/TUI source projection is `steipete`.
